LanguageData.LP_HeroicSpark.degreeDatas.colorE08A3Aco:

LanguageData.LP_TotemSpirit.degreeDatas.color5B9BD5co:

The spirit of the wolf pack hunts alongside {PAWN_nameDef}.

The spirit of the eagle watches the distance for {PAWN_nameDef}.

- When shooting, the reduction from the target's cover is halved (doesn't stack with Sharpshooter)
- Ranged weapon range ×1.15

LanguageData.LP_SpellWarded.degreeDatas.color5B9BD5co:
Magic always slips off {PAWN_nameDef}.

- Enemy psychic, spell and divine damage -35% (weaponless damage, staff damage)
- Enemy stuns, charms, domination and psychic blasts have a 50% chance to fail
- Only resists hostile casters; friendly buff spells work as usual
- Cost: psychic sensitivity -20%
{PAWN_nameDef} is best one-on-one.

- With only one enemy adjacent (within 1.5 cells): melee hit +25%, melee dodge +25%, and a successful dodge has a 50% chance of an instant counterattack
- With 3 or more enemies close in: melee hit -10%
(The number of nearby enemies updates every 4 seconds)
LanguageData.LP_Prophesied.degreeDatas.colorE0B040col:
On the day {PAWN_nameDef} was born, someone spoke a prophecy (see the prophecy below the tooltip).

Awakened: fate unfinished: until the prophecy is fulfilled, lethal wounds down you instead and stop bleeding (cooldown 20 days); +25% damage against the prophecy's target.
Manifest (adventurer level 10): fate unfinished cooldown 12 days; when {PAWN_pronoun} is downed, allies within 5 cells get "for the child of prophecy" hit +10% (1 hour).
Exalted (prophecy fulfilled): gains all the XP needed for the next level at once, and the whole colony gets "prophecy fulfilled" mood +8 (10 days); fate unfinished is replaced by master of fate: once per day, the next attack always hits for ×2 damage.
LanguageData.LP_PactDestiny.degreeDatas.colorE0B040co:
{PAWN_nameDef} has a pact with an archdevil of the Nine Hells.

All stages: Pactbound Eldritch Blast (12 damage per beam, 1/2/3/4 beams at levels 1/5/11/17, cooldown 4 seconds, no neural heat).
Awakened: each kill grants temporary damage absorption of 15 + adventurer level (up to 60).
Manifest (level 10): eldritch blast hits ignite the target.
Exalted (legendary adventurer): fire damage -50%; once per day "Straight to hell" (single target, 60 burn damage over 10 seconds, target can't move meanwhile).
Pact payment: every 15-20 days the patron makes a demand: within 3 days execute a prisoner or pay 500 silver. Failure → patron's wrath for 10 days (eldritch blast unusable, mood -10); two failures in a row drop one stage, and further consecutive failures at the awakened stage remove the trait with "forsaken pact" mood -15 (15 days).

{PAWN_nameDef} has a pact with the Fey Queen.

All stages: Pactbound Eldritch Blast (12 damage per beam, 1/2/3/4 beams at levels 1/5/11/17, cooldown 4 seconds, no neural heat).
Awakened: Fey Step: teleport within 8 cells, cooldown 30 seconds.
Manifest (level 10): when hit, 20% chance to confuse the attacker for 3 seconds.
Exalted (legendary adventurer): once per day "Fey charm": enemies within 6 cells are dazed for 10 seconds (no effect on bosses).
Pact payment: every 15-20 days the patron makes a demand: within 3 days hold a party / wedding, or hand over an artwork of excellent quality or better. Failure → patron's wrath for 10 days (eldritch blast unusable, mood -10); two failures in a row drop one stage, and further consecutive failures at the awakened stage remove the trait with "forsaken pact" mood -15 (15 days).

{PAWN_nameDef} heard whispers from beyond the stars in a dream, and answered them.

All stages: Pactbound Eldritch Blast (12 damage per beam, 1/2/3/4 beams at levels 1/5/11/17, cooldown 4 seconds, no neural heat).
Awakened: psychic sensitivity +20%.
Manifest (level 10): eldritch blast hits stun the target for 1 second (once per 10 seconds per target).
Exalted (legendary adventurer): once per day "Otherworldly tentacles": enemies in a radius-3 area are trapped for 15 seconds and keep taking damage.
Pact payment: every 15-20 days the patron makes a demand: within 3 days meditate personally for 8 hours or study a Netherese scroll for 1 hour. Failure → patron's wrath for 10 days (eldritch blast unusable, mood -10); two failures in a row drop one stage, and further consecutive failures at the awakened stage remove the trait with "forsaken pact" mood -15 (15 days).
LanguageData.LP_WeaveChild.degreeDatas.colorE0B040col:
The Weave flows like water around {PAWN_nameDef}.

Awakened: staff damage +20%; with VPE, psycast neural heat cost -25%, without it psychic sensitivity +15%.
Manifest (adventurer level 10): each cast has a 15% chance to trigger no cooldown; without VPE, staff range +3 instead.
Exalted (legendary adventurer): once per day "Weave surge": for 60 seconds casting costs no neural heat and triggers no cooldown; Weave tremors and Weave collapse have no effect on {PAWN_objective}.
